name: Jing-Ren Wang
affiliation: Schwarzman College, Tsinghua University, Beijing, China
evidence: Printed in arXiv 2411.06032 as 'Jingren Wang', equal-contribution author under 'Schwarzman College, Tsinghua University, Beijing, China'. Full PDF text checked: no email addresses anywhere in the paper; the LLM-GLOBE GitHub repo has no contact file. OpenAlex attaches ORCID 0000-0002-1859-8018 to this authorship, but that ORCID record (pub.orcid.org/v3.0/0000-0002-1859-8018/record) belongs to a different Jingren Wang - its only work is a 2020 JCI Insight cell-biology paper on Cdc42/EGFR-MAPK in intestinal epithelium - so it is a namesake merge and was rejected; it also exposes no email. Web search surfaced a Minerva University class-of-2021 alumna Jingren Wang awarded a Schwarzman Scholarship (minerva.edu blog) and a LinkedIn 'Jingren Wang' at Microsoft in Shanghai, but neither is tied to this paper, its co-authors or its topic, and neither prints an email. 'Jingren Wang' matches many people; with no independent anchor and no printed address, recorded as not found. GitHub route also exhausted: cloned the LLM-GLOBE repo; `git log --all` shows only 'raovish6 | 93843444+raovish6@users.noreply.github.com' (repo owner Vishwanatha Rao, masked noreply address - rejected), zero forks, no other contributors. GitHub user search for "Jingren Wang" returns two accounts (wjrforcyber, a student in Guangzhou; JrenW, empty profile); neither lists an email nor has any link to this paper, its co-authors or its topic, so both were rejected as unanchored namesakes.
